newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rupee weak vs dlr on expected NOC demand.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rupee weak vs dlr on expected NOC demand.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened lower at 56.88/90 rupees per dollar on Thursday against the previous close of 56.85 rupees, dealers said.
Dealers said that the rupee may fall further in view of demand from the state-owned Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC) for import of petroleum products.
"One of the two payments is due in next week, while the amount payable can total to $13 million," a dealer said.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.
Inter-bank call money rates opened at 4.50-5.00 percent on Thursday, dealers said. "There is good liquidity in the market, which will keep the call rates on the lower side," another dealer said.
